snippet.title: Category Connections - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now! https://CategoryConnections.com/

Category Connections is a chill puzzle game where you sort 3,000 things into 100 categories. No timers, no stress, just a big grid of things for you to organize. Perfect for a rainy afternoon. Coming 2027.

https://TrampolineTales.com/
